clue.text: Thinks out how to pronounce Wilts town

indicators.note: asking how a word is pronounced points to a word that is said the same way as the place

parts.note: Devizes is a market town in Wiltshire (Wilts), a county in southwest England

explanation.surface: Someone works out the correct way to say the name of a Wiltshire town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'how to pronounce' signals a homophone: the town DEVIZES, in the English county of Wiltshire, is said exactly like the verb meaning plans or invents.
explanation.definitionFit: To devise a plan is to invent or work it out mentally.

clue.text: Westminster wife?

parts.note: read as a politician's spouse, but it means the wife of the Duke of Westminster, a peer's title

explanation.surface: A politician's spouse at Westminster.
explanation.walkthrough: Westminster suggests Parliament, but it is a dukedom, and a duke's wife holds the matching title.
explanation.definitionFit: The wife of a duke, such as the Duke of Westminster, takes the corresponding noble title.

clue.text: Five Irish poems

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
Erse is a name for the Irish Gaelic language

explanation.surface: Five poems written in Irish.
explanation.definitionFit: Verse is poetry, a collective word for poems.

clue.text: Liberal Japanese drink is around to quench thirst

indicators.note: the drink is said to be around the other piece, wrapping it

parts.note: sake is Japanese rice wine
L is the abbreviation for Liberal, a British political party

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician's sake is to hand to ease his thirst.
explanation.definitionFit: To slake a thirst is to satisfy or quench it.

clue.text: Boy holding list of cheese

indicators.note: the first piece is holding the second inside it

parts.note: a son is a boy
a ship lists when it tilts or leans

explanation.surface: A boy clutching a list of cheeses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'list' looks like a written list, but it is the verb for a ship leaning over.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilton is a blue-veined English cheese.

clue.text: It shows how powerful electrical equipment can be

definitions.text: It shows how powerful electrical equipment can be

parts.words: It shows how powerful electrical equipment can be
parts.note: read plainly, a description of the power rating printed on an appliance, measured in units named after James Watt

explanation.surface: A plain description of a figure on an appliance label stating its power.
explanation.definitionFit: The power rating of a device, expressed in watts, is its measure of power consumption.

clue.text: Attractive, but be only partly successful?

definitions.meaning: as a phrase, to succeed in some cases but not all, winning a few

explanation.definitionFit: Charming and engaging people are attractive; split in two, the word also means succeed in some contests.

clue.text: Job for extremely capable working party

parts.note: a task is a job
taken as written

indicators.note: extremely means the extreme letters, first and last, of the word capable

explanation.surface: A job for a very competent team of workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' looks like an adverb intensifying capable, but it takes the first and last letters, C and E.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit formed for a specific operation is a working party or group.

clue.text: Government opponent

parts.note: read as a member of the parliamentary opposition, but it means someone against all government

explanation.surface: A politician who opposes the government.
explanation.walkthrough: The obvious reading is an opposition MP; the answer opposes government itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who rejects all government and state authority advocates lawlessness.

clue.text: Excitable general going to blow up

indicators.note: excitable letters cannot stay still, so they are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A hot-headed general is about to explode.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Excitable' rearranges GENERAL; 'blow up' means magnify, not explode.
explanation.definitionFit: To blow up a photograph is to make it bigger.

clue.text: Perhaps buttonhole people next to vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a nation is a people sharing a country

explanation.surface: A crowd of people standing beside a car, as if at a wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks the definition as an example: a buttonhole is a flower worn in the lapel, often this one.
explanation.definitionFit: A buttonhole is a flower worn in a lapel, and this bloom is a classic choice.

clue.text: Humble start for shopping arcade

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, here taken from the word shopping

parts.note: a mall is a shopping arcade

explanation.surface: A modest beginning for a retail arcade.
explanation.definitionFit: Humble and modest beginnings are little or minor ones.

clue.text: Peak the day before holiday

parts.note: the eve is the day before an event
a rest is a break or holiday from work

explanation.surface: Someone notes the summit they reach the day before their break.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's highest mountain is a Himalayan summit.

clue.text: Not working, the freezer? This could be major

parts.note: a machine that is off is not working
an icer is something that freezes or ices

explanation.surface: A broken freezer, with the hint that this might be a big problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'major' looks like an adjective meaning serious, but it is the army rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A major is an army rank, an example of a commissioned soldier.

clue.text: Division as spiritualist meeting receives priest back

indicators.note: one piece receives another, taking it inside itself

parts.note: a seance is a meeting to contact spirits

indicators.note: back means the word for priest is read from right to left

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a priest

explanation.surface: A rift opens when a priest returns to a seance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses the priest's title to VER; 'receives' puts that inside the spiritualist meeting. 'Division' is the noun for a cutting apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A severance is a cutting off or separation.

clue.text: Scarlet painting eaten up by rats

indicators.note: something eaten by another is swallowed inside it

parts.note: rats are vermin

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an oil is an oil painting

explanation.surface: A red painting gnawed by rats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses the painting word to LIO, as in a down clue; 'eaten' puts it inside the rats word. 'Scarlet' is a colour, not a sinful woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Vermilion is a brilliant red, like scarlet.

clue.text: Hurry with delicate candle

parts.note: to rush is to hurry
light means delicate or slight

explanation.surface: Someone hurries with a fragile candle.
explanation.walkthrough: A rushlight is an old cheap candle made from the pith of a rush dipped in fat.
explanation.definitionFit: A rushlight was a crude candle made from rush pith soaked in tallow.

clue.text: Soldiers I have to rob

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
've is the shortened form of have, as in I've

explanation.surface: Soldiers announce that they have to commit robbery.
explanation.walkthrough: REIVE is an old Scots and Northern English word for raiding or plundering, as the Border reivers did.
explanation.definitionFit: To reive is an old Scottish verb meaning to raid or plunder.

clue.text: Runs game

definitions.meaning: ... as a verb means dashes or moves quickly
a pub game of throwing small arrows at a board

explanation.definitionFit: Darts can be quick dashes and also the pub board game with thrown arrows.

clue.text: Solemnly announce medical disaster

indicators.note: a disaster leaves things in a mess, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Gravely announcing a medical catastrophe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disaster' rearranges MEDICAL.
explanation.definitionFit: To declaim is to speak in an impassioned, rhetorical way.

clue.text: Happy to study under canvas

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn
tented means covered by a tent, as campers under canvas are

explanation.surface: Someone is pleased to do their studying while camping.
explanation.definitionFit: Being satisfied and at peace means being pleased with one's lot.

clue.text: Superintendent, the wretch, drawing up duty list

parts.note: a cur is a contemptible wretch

indicators.note: in a down clue, drawing up means the word is pulled upward and so read backwards

parts.note: a rota is a list of duties

explanation.surface: A supervisor, a nasty piece of work, compiling a duty roster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawing up' looks like compiling the list, but it reverses ROTA to ATOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A curator is a keeper in charge of a museum or collection, an overseer.

clue.text: What babies need — sleep and food

parts.note: a nap is a short sleep
pies are food

explanation.surface: A list of infant needs: a sleep and something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the two needs are the answer; they are the parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies wear these absorbent cloth or disposable pants (diapers in American English).

clue.text: Cart round cloth to be put up for hangings

indicators.note: the cart goes round the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a dray is a low cart, as used by brewers

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting up means the word is turned to read from bottom to top

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric

explanation.surface: A cart carries cloth to be hung as curtains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be put up' reverses the cloth to PER, as in a down clue; 'round' wraps the cart about it. 'hangings' means curtains, not executions.
explanation.definitionFit: Curtains and draped fabric hung in folds are hangings.

clue.text: Not so well after central heating's made cooler

indicators.note: after places the sickness comparison behind the heating abbreviation in the answer

parts.note: CH is the standard abbreviation for central heating, as in estate agents' ads
iller means sicker, not so well

explanation.surface: Someone feels worse after the heating has made the room colder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the second-named piece first; 'made' is a link. 'cooler' looks like an adjective but is a noun, a refrigerating machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiller is a refrigerating unit, something that cools.

clue.text: Criticise expert with a fix for everything

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A critic attacks an expert who claims a universal cure.
explanation.definitionFit: A panacea is a supposed universal remedy or cure-all.

clue.text: Jog naked around front of garden

indicators.note: the word for naked goes around the other piece

parts.note: nude means naked

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter, here of garden

explanation.surface: Running naked around the front garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jog' looks like running, but it means a gentle push.
explanation.definitionFit: To jog someone's elbow is to give it a light push.

clue.text: Flier that can offer a lift

definitions.meaning: a lifting machine on a building site

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a tall wading bird and a hoisting machine.

clue.text: A part of mansion that's astonishing?

parts.note: a wing is a section of a large house

explanation.surface: A section of a stately home that is amazing.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the punning definition: awing means filling with awe, so astonishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Inspiring awe in someone is to amaze or overwhelm them.

clue.text: Lousy trader hit badly

indicators.note: badly signals that the words are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A dealer who has had a bad blow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges the letters of TRADER and HIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something poor or inferior in quality is dismissed as lousy.

clue.text: Screen shows lizard

definitions.meaning: a large tropical reptile of Africa, Asia and Australia

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a display screen and a large tropical reptile.

clue.text: Nice view from the flats

definitions.meaning: flats are painted panels of stage set, which together form the backdrop

explanation.definitionFit: Landscape views and painted stage backdrops (flats) both go by this word.
